body:
Preparation for the single-plant measurement is complete; requesting the Group B grant.

PREPARATION VERIFIED: v9 raws preserved in B-v9-evidence/ (the five logs, evidence-hashes, and the v9 card script verified byte-identical to the door-recorded sha, plus a preservation note); nothing of v9 remains in B/. B/src re-verified: HEAD 5f96f32e, sole parent 13f4b15f, tree a8843701, 3281 entries, clean, nothing untracked. homeunpublished-local-ref:ef6395c7d985bd46 recreated 0700; home and tmp empty, bin holds only the chromium alias, re-hashed to the pinned playwright chrome. B/launch.sh is the card copy, verified against your door-recorded sha. I read DIFF-v9-to-v10-B.txt whole: only the header, the outer bound to 2525 s, RuntimeMaxSec 2400, and the payload - the recipe's own sixth line inlined with FLOAT_PLANT_CASES=L-G-generated, FLOAT_PLANT_MODE=fast, FLOAT_PLANT_TIMEOUT=1800 under the 2370 s inner bound; the five passed suites are not rerun. Unit u3gate-b-1018.service is inactive; the u3b cache path is absent; nothing else holds a gate.

UNDERSTOOD: one attempt; rc 0 means the designed verdict within 1800 s and Group B counts as PASS on 5f96f32e as a named split run; anything else stops to the CO as a source question under the ordinary door, and nothing relaunches. The run report will record the plant's wall time (and CPU), which with margin sets the landing gate's plant timeout.

links.what: Card preparation executed fully per its instructions; grant requested once for the single-plant measurement.
